dialogues.jp: 「おっ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm?"

dialogues.jp:
桜並木を着物を着た女の子が、両親に連れられ
て歩いていた。
dialogues.en:
I could see a little girl in a kimono, walking with her
parents on an avenue full of cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text:
I could see a little girl in a kimono, walking with her
parents on an avenue full of cherry blossoms.

dialogues.jp: 今日、何度目かの光景。
dialogues.en: I'd seen this several times today.
dialogues.text: I'd seen this several times today.

dialogues.jp: 「ひな祭りだからな」
dialogues.en: "It's the Dolls' Festival today......"
dialogues.text: "It's the Dolls' Festival today......"

dialogues.jp:
今日は、普段の休日よりもさらに人通りが多い。
島中が華やいでいる感じだ。
dialogues.en:
It seems there are more people out today than any other
weekend. The whole island's filled with a cheerful
atmosphere.
dialogues.text:
It seems there are more people out today than any other
weekend. The whole island's filled with a cheerful
atmosphere.

dialogues.jp: 音夢になんか買っていってやるか……。
dialogues.en: Maybe I'll get something for Nemu......
dialogues.text: Maybe I'll get something for Nemu......

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく島の雰囲気にあてられて、商店街に
足が向く。
dialogues.en: Influenced by the atmosphere, I headed toward the city.
dialogues.text: Influenced by the atmosphere, I headed toward the city.

dialogues.jp:
商店街はとても大盛況なようで、人がごった返
していた。
dialogues.en: The city was very crowded today, and it was full of people.
dialogues.text: The city was very crowded today, and it was full of people.

dialogues.jp:
「ったく、どうしてみんな行動パターンが一緒
　なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why is everyone thinking the same thing?"
dialogues.text: "Why is everyone thinking the same thing?"

dialogues.jp:
他人と一緒だなんて、全然つまんないだろうが。
もっと個性を持たなきゃ。
dialogues.en: People should be more independent, and do different things.
dialogues.text: People should be more independent, and do different things.

dialogues.jp:
「夜中に買い物に出るとか、日の出とともに眠
　るとか」
dialogues.en:
"They should go shopping in the middle of the night, and go
to sleep when the sun comes up."
dialogues.text:
"They should go shopping in the middle of the night, and go
to sleep when the sun comes up."

dialogues.jp: どこの業界の話だ？
dialogues.en: What kind of world am I talking about?
dialogues.text: What kind of world am I talking about?

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、せっかく来たんだから、なんか買って
　くか」
dialogues.en: "Well, now that I'm here, I might as well buy something."
dialogues.text: "Well, now that I'm here, I might as well buy something."

dialogues.jp:
このまま何もしないで帰ったんじゃ、悲しいほ
ど時間と体力の無駄になる。
dialogues.en:
It'll be a waste of time and energy if I go home without
doing anything.
dialogues.text:
It'll be a waste of time and energy if I go home without
doing anything.

dialogues.jp: とはいえ、何を買ったらいいやら。
dialogues.en: But then, what should I get her?
dialogues.text: But then, what should I get her?

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ……どうすっかな」
dialogues.en: "Hmm...... What shall I do?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm...... What shall I do?"

dialogues.jp:
人の流れについていくように歩きながら、ぼん
やりと店頭の商品を眺めていく。
dialogues.en: I walked along with the crowd as I continued to window-shop.
dialogues.text: I walked along with the crowd as I continued to window-shop.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あれ、朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura?"

dialogues.jp: 知った声に足を止める。
dialogues.en: I stopped as I heard a familiar voice.
dialogues.text: I stopped as I heard a familiar voice.

dialogues.jp:
「眞子か。それに萌先輩も。こんなところで何
　をしてるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey Mako, and Moe-sempai too! What are you two doing here?"
dialogues.text: "Hey Mako, and Moe-sempai too! What are you two doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「自主練が終わったんで、お姉ちゃんと買い物」
dialogues.en:
"I'm shopping with my sister because we're done with our
lesson."
dialogues.text:
"I'm shopping with my sister because we're done with our
lesson."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「弟の誕生日プレゼントを買いに来たんです」
dialogues.en: "We're here to pick out a birthday present for our brother."
dialogues.text: "We're here to pick out a birthday present for our brother."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ、そうなんだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, really?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, really?"

dialogues.jp:
姉妹で弟のプレゼント選びとは、ふたりとも弟
思いなんだな。
dialogues.en: What caring sisters they are!
dialogues.text: What caring sisters they are!

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんたなら、プレゼントに何が欲しい？」
dialogues.en: "If it was you, what would you want for a present?"
dialogues.text: "If it was you, what would you want for a present?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「カネ」
dialogues.en: "Money."
dialogues.text: "Money."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まじめに答えなさいよね。他には？」
dialogues.en: "Be more serious! What else would you want?"
dialogues.text: "Be more serious! What else would you want?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「豪邸」
dialogues.en: "A mansion."
dialogues.text: "A mansion."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「三途の川がどれだけ冷たいか知りたいみたい
　ね……」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「もう一回だけ｛き／訊｝いてあげる。何が欲しい？」
dialogues.en: "This is your last chance. What would you want?"
dialogues.text: "This is your last chance. What would you want?"

dialogues.jp: そうだなぁ……
dialogues.en: Let me see......
dialogues.text: Let me see......

dialogues.jp: ◆プレゼントは何が？◆
dialogues.en: ◆What for the present?◆
dialogues.text: ◆What for the present?◆

dialogues.jp:
商店街をぶらついていると、ばったりと萌先輩
と眞子に出会った。
dialogues.en:
When I was wandering around the city, I bumped into
Moe-sempai and Mako.
dialogues.text:
When I was wandering around the city, I bumped into
Moe-sempai and Mako.

dialogues.jp:
何でも、弟さんの誕生日プレゼントを探してい
るらしい。そして、それには何が良いかを、俺
に尋ねてきたのだが……。
dialogues.en:
They're looking for a birthday present for their brother.
They asked me what I'd want if it was me......
dialogues.text:
They're looking for a birthday present for their brother.
They asked me what I'd want if it was me......
